note.zh-TW: 期末若有大量沒用完的用品，實務上可以列為資產；本課金額小，直接列費用。
note.en: In practice a large stock of unused supplies at period end can be recorded as an asset; the course expenses them directly because the amounts are small.

definition.zh-TW: 買紙張、文具等事務用品的支出。本課在買進時就全部列為費用。
definition.en: Spending on paper, stationery and similar office supplies. The course expenses them when they are bought.
